rateCards.name: Accommodation tariff · 2026–27
rateCards.guestNote: A child charge and an extra-adult charge never stack on the same guest.

policies.title: Cancellation & refunds
policies.body:
Cancellations are measured from the scheduled check-in date at the property.

• 30 days or more before check-in — free cancellation; no charge.
• 15–29 days before check-in — 25% of the total booking value.
• 7–14 days before check-in — 50% of the total booking value.
• Under 7 days, including no-shows — 100% of the total booking value.

Refunds, where due, are processed to the original payment method within 14 working days of written confirmation from the vendor desk.

policies.title: Stay rules & blackouts
policies.body:
Minimum stay and blackout rules override season rates when they conflict.

• 20 Dec 2026 – 02 Jan 2027 — minimum stay of 3 nights. Shorter stays must be refused, not repriced.
• 15 Apr – 30 Sep 2026 — minimum stay of 1 night.
• 25 Dec 2026 — property closed for a private event. Hard blackout; do not sell.
• Check-out night is not charged on any date.

policies.title: Tax treatment
policies.body: Published room and meal rates on this card already include applicable GST. Do not add tax again when costing proposals from this card.

policies.title: Charging basis
policies.body: Accommodation is sold per room, per night. Meal plans follow the same room-night basis. Extra adult and child rates are applied per person, per night as listed on the guest schedule.

policies.title: Check-in & check-out
policies.body:
Standard check-in is from 14:00 on the arrival date.
Standard check-out is by 11:00 on the departure date.

Early check-in before 10:00 is complimentary when the property confirms availability. Late check-out is subject to room availability and may attract a half-day charge.

policies.title: Currency
policies.body: All amounts on this rate card are denominated in Indian Rupees (INR). Cross-currency conversions are not offered by the property.

policies.title: Rate type
policies.body: Rates on this card are net and non-commissionable. The agency costs from the net column only. Any published retail figure shown by the resort is for reference and is not used for proposals.

policies.title: Child age proof
policies.body: Child age bands on this card are verified against passport (or government ID) at check-in. Incorrect age declarations may be re-rated to the adult extra-bed charge for the full stay.

policies.title: Payment terms
policies.body:
A deposit of 50% of the total booking value is due on confirmation.
The balance is due no later than 21 days before check-in.

Bookings made inside 21 days of arrival require full payment at confirmation.

policies.title: Amendment fee
policies.body: Date and room amendments after confirmation are not offered as a paid service on this card. Changes are treated as a cancellation of the original booking plus a new booking at the rates then in force.

rateCardTemplates.label: Accommodation
rateCardTemplates.blurb: Hotels, resorts, houseboats and villas priced per night.
rateCardTemplates.detail: Season × meal plan price matrix, per-night quoting.

rateCardTemplates.label: Flight
rateCardTemplates.blurb: Air tickets issued outside Paryatech, with the agency’s own fees carded here.
rateCardTemplates.detail: Travel period × passenger type, fare captured as an actual at booking.

rateCardTemplates.label: Trip
rateCardTemplates.blurb: DMC FIT packages with a contracted per-person rate and a named itinerary.
rateCardTemplates.detail: Departure window × occupancy slab, per-person quoting.

rateCardTemplates.label: Visa
rateCardTemplates.blurb: Visa service fees from a processing partner — not a hotel grid and not a case file.
rateCardTemplates.detail: Destination × nationality × apply-from × category × applicant × processing tier.

rateCardTemplates.label: Cruise
rateCardTemplates.blurb: Sailings priced per cabin grade and berth occupancy, with port charges.
rateCardTemplates.detail: Sailing date × cabin grade × occupancy, per-cabin quoting.

rateCardTemplates.label: Fixed transfer
rateCardTemplates.blurb: Private vehicle price for a defined one-way route.

rateCardTemplates.label: Local package
rateCardTemplates.blurb: Local duty with included hours and kilometres.
rateCardTemplates.detail: Vehicle × package price, plus excess usage.

rateCardTemplates.label: Outstation per km
rateCardTemplates.detail: Vehicle kilometre rate and shared minimum rules.

rateCardTemplates.label: Daily hire
rateCardTemplates.blurb: Private vehicle retained for one or more days.
rateCardTemplates.detail: Vehicle day rate, included usage and excess.

rateCardTemplates.label: Activity
rateCardTemplates.blurb: Supplier prices for an activity's linked service options.
rateCardTemplates.detail: Per person, per booking/group or per unit.
